title: Every per-shift/day "before you work it" preview (Add-Shift, calendar tiles, weekend-pickup suggestion, goal shift-count) uses a flat keepRatio approximation that silently ignores percent-type custom withholdings, while the hero/Breakdown use the real computeNet math that does account for them
where: index.html:2818-2820 (keepRatio definition) used at 3434, 3919, 3933, 4104-4105/4245-4246, and Settings 4746
detail: `keepRatio = Math.max(0, 1-(federalTaxRate+stateTaxRate+ficaForPreview)/100)` (2819-2820) is the marginal take-home ratio used for every *individual* shift/day figure shown before a shift is committed: the Add-Shift sheet's 'This shift adds ... take-home' preview (4104-4105, 4245-4246), the 'Pick up a weekend night?' suggestion (3434, 3512), every calendar day tile's ~$ amount and aria-label (3919, 3933), and the Settings goal line's '≈ N typical 12h shifts to reach this' (4746, `per = baseRate*12*keepRatio`). It correctly omits flat-dollar pretax/posttax/custom deductions (those don't scale with one more shift, so excluding them from a marginal ratio is right), but it also omits `customWithholdings` entries of type `'percent'`, which computeNet (1243) *does* apply proportionally to every dollar of gross -- so they should be part of the marginal rate too. Verified: a shift priced at $600 gross with a 5% percent-type custom withholding plus 12% federal/5% state/7.65% FICA previews as +$452 take-home via keepRatio but nets only +$422 once actually computed via computeNet -- a 7% systematic overstatement that recurs on every shift with that data shape, silently, with no hedge beyond the generic 'about'.
failure: A nurse with a percent-type custom withholding configured (e.g. an extra state withholding percentage, a percent-based garnishment or retirement match modeled that way) would see every pre-commit preview -- the number the whole app exists to get right -- consistently promise more take-home than what actually lands in the hero/Breakdown once the shift is added, which is exactly the class of surprise the product is built to prevent.
fix: Fold each percent-type entry in customWithholdings into keepRatio's subtraction the same way fed/state/fica already are, e.g. `keepRatio = 1 - (federalTaxRate+stateTaxRate+ficaForPreview+percentCW)/100` where percentCW sums `customWithholdings.filter(w=>w.type==='percent').map(w=>+w.amount||0)`. Low severity because this data shape currently has no Settings UI to create it at all (grep confirms `customWithholdings`/`setCW` is only read from Export/Import JSON and the paystub scanner never populates it -- verified in parsePDF/applyPaystub, lines 3333-3383) -- today it is unreachable through normal in-app use, so flag it as a latent bug that will bite the moment that field gets a Settings affordance, not an active one.
